columns.name: Geography Type
columns.description: Whether the record is for a Community Area or a ZIP Code

columns.name: Community Area or ZIP Code
columns.description: The Community Area or ZIP Code

columns.name: Community Area Name
columns.description: Blank if the record is for a ZIP Code.

columns.name: Rank - Adults with no PCP
columns.description: Adults aged 18-64 years with no primary care provider.

columns.name: Rank - Cumulative Mobility Ratio
columns.description: Ratio of mobility in 2020 compared to 2019.

columns.name: Rank - Frontline Essential Workers
columns.description: Percentage of  the CA population that work as frontline essential workers.

columns.name: Rank - Age 65+
columns.description: Percentage of the CA population that are adults aged 65+.

columns.name: Rank - Comorbid Conditions
columns.description: Percentage of the CA population that are adults aged 18-64 years with one or more comorbid conditions.

columns.name: Rank - COVID-19 Hospital Admission Rate
columns.description: Cumulative hospital admission rate Jan 1 - Dec 31 2020.

columns.name: Rank - COVID-19 Crude Mortality Rate
columns.description: Cumulative non-congregate living situation deaths that occurred from Jan 1 - Dec 31 2020.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: A point within the Community Area or ZIP Code to allow for geographic analysis. The precise point shown has no other meaning.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
